{{Quote|We are forever grateful to the Jedi Knights for the salvation of our people from the horrible drug that's tearing apart our nests.|Kimar Walc publicly thanking the [[Jedi]]|<ref name="HNN55" />}}
'''Kimar Walc''' was a [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] spokesperson<ref name="HNN55" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|regional/1359_2.html|Arconan Smuggling Cartel Dismantled}} is set on the date 13:5:9 which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> the cartel [[Crime lord/Legends|kingpin]] [[Lojrak Shrag]], who dealt the drug [[Salt/Legends|salt]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cona/Legends|Cona]], was arrested by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Tassida Judrelle]], [[Quarmall]], and [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]]. Walc's statement thanking the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] for the arrest and stating his hope for rebuilding was included in a report of the arrests by the [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] of [[HoloNet News]].<ref name="HNN55" />

At some point no earlier than [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], Walc had the position of [[Nest Leader]] of<ref name="EGAS" /> the clearing on Cona<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> known as the [[Grand Nest]] and had a [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Denn Walc]].<ref name="EGAS" />
